A Digital Twin is a virtual representation of a physical asset, system, or process. It combines real-time data, 3D
models,
and simulations to create a dynamic digital counterpart that reflects the actual state and behaviour of the physical
entity.
Benefits of Digital Twin Technology:
 Enhanced Visualization: Offers a 3D view of assets, making it easier to understand complex systems.
 Real-time Monitoring: Integrates IoT data for continuous tracking of performance and health.
 Predictive Maintenance: Analyzes data to forecast potential failures, reducing downtime and maintenance costs.
 Improved Design and Engineering: Facilitates better design choices through simulation and scenario analysis.
 Operational Efficiency: Optimizes processes and resource management through data-driven insights.What is a Digital
Twin?
